method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

checks.command: l4 run ccwa-cases-jurisdiction.l4; l4 run ccwa-qa-cases.l4; l4 check ccwa-qa.l4
checks.result: 307 assertions satisfied (45 + 262), 0 errors, 0 warnings, in every file; l4 check ccwa-qa.l4 succeeds

scope: ss 3, 19 (who is a child for a charge), 19A-19D, 30(1) (which court deals with the charge; the election for trial on indictment; joint trial with an adult; transfer at 18), 19(4) (prescribed penalty election), 21(2), (4), 22 (sentencing limits of the Court as constituted), 23 (parent's attendance), 28 and 40 (rehearing; President's reconsideration), 31, 33, 34 (who may be present; disclosure after a closed hearing; understanding the proceedings), 35, 36, 36AA, 36A (publication of identity and disclosure of outcome)
seat: the child before the court (Jake at 15)

roles: I am the child charged, or I was a child when the offence is said to have happened
I am a parent or guardian of the child
I am the victim of the offence, or someone else affected by it
I publish or broadcast reports, or would pass on what happened in the case

situation_parameters.name: how the case in the Children's Court has ended
situation_parameters.description: How the case in the Children's Court has ended, if it has: not yet; the charge was dismissed; or the child was found guilty or convicted, and an order was made (the questions on what follows arise only once it has ended)
situation_parameters.role: I am the child charged, or I was a child when the offence is said to have happened
questions: Is the order against me saved though the explanation fell short
May someone other than me tell this person how my case ended
Can I ask the President to reconsider the order made against me
May I apply for my case to be reheard
May I tell this person how my child's case ended
May I tell this person how the child's case ended, as the victim
May I pass on how the child's case ended
does_not_arise: the charge was dismissed (for the three questions of ss 28, 34(3) and 40 only)

qa_layer.notes: NOTES.md, "Q&A layer (seat and situations as parameters)"
